content.short: HypurrScan is a community block explorer for Hyperliquid, covering HyperCore activity alongside HyperEVM.
content.description: HypurrScan is an explorer built specifically for Hyperliquid and not adapted from a general EVM scanner. It surfaces the parts of the network a standard explorer misses, including HyperCore order book activity, staking and vault movements, and the flows between Core and the EVM layer. Its operators also run a Hyperliquid validator that accepts HYPE delegations.
content.meta: HypurrScan is a Hyperliquid block explorer covering HyperCore and HyperEVM activity in one interface.
